title: An unramified flat morphism of schemes is formally etale: the conormal sheaf dies by open-diagonal localization
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For X -> S unramified and flat of schemes, the lemma concludes formally etale, i.e. C_{X/S} = 0 (formally unramified being known). The retained proof is complete: unramified gives Delta : X -> X x_S X an open immersion (Morphisms, lemma diagonal-unramified-morphism); q : X x_S X -> X stays formally unramified (chapter lemmas unramified-formally-unramified, base-change-formally-unramified) while p is flat by base change, so the flat-fibre-product conormal identification (chapter lemma universal-thickening-fibre-product-flat) gives p^*C_{X/S} = C_q; Delta(X) maps isomorphically to X through q, and localization of the universal thickening (this wave's L16228 spaces twin of the same mechanism; for schemes the same identification is in-source) kills C_q on Delta(X), hence C_{X/S} pulls back to zero along the identity and vanishes. Retained author proof at lines 1630-1652.
